name: Subactor LLM Account Hub
summary: Control-governed account/provider/tool URI boundary for Hub scoped MCP bindings.
description: Discovers account-scoped MCP bindings and delegates status, plan and execution only through typed Subactor Control APIs. Execution requires a Control-issued container.cli.execute grant, a matching runnable intent and a currently verified safety authority; Control also completes the intent and revokes the grant. The connector never creates authority or exposes its deployment token.
